# GitHub Gist

> > GitHub Gist is a simple way to share code snippets, notes, and files with version control and syntax highlighting.

GitHub Gist allows developers to share standalone code files, configuration scripts, documentation, and technical notes. Each gist can contain multiple files and supports Markdown rendering, making it useful for sharing examples, troubleshooting guides, and collaborative coding.

## Key Topics

- Code snippets
- Version control
- Syntax highlighting
- Markdown support
- File sharing
- Collaboration
- GitHub integration
- Public and private gists
- Embedded gists
- Git repository
- Developer tools
- Configuration files
- Technical documentation
